**Summary of findings:**
- **Test image**: Green banana bunch with brown, dry rotting concentrated at the distal (blossom/tip) ends of individual banana fingers, with some brown decay also on the rachis/stalk. The rest of the bananas remain green.
- **Cigar End Rot** reference: Matches perfectly — dark brown, dry, shriveled rot starting at the flower end of banana fingers (the "cigar" appearance).
- **Anthracnose** reference: Scattered dark spots over ripe yellow bananas — doesn't match.
- **Panama Disease** reference: Leaf yellowing/chlorosis — completely different.

The characteristic tip rot pattern (blossom-end rotting while fruit body remains green) is the hallmark of Cigar End Rot.
